    26	#define NDPI_CURRENT_PROTO NDPI_PROTOCOL_AMAZON_VIDEO
    27	
    28	#include "ndpi_api.h"
    29	
    30	static void ndpi_check_amazon_video(struct ndpi_detection_module_struct *ndpi_struct,
    31	                                  struct ndpi_flow_struct *flow) {
    32	
    33	  struct ndpi_packet_struct *packet = &flow->packet;
    34	
    35	  NDPI_LOG_DBG(ndpi_struct, "search Amazon Prime\n");
    36	
    37	  if((packet->tcp != NULL) &&
    38	      (packet->payload[0] == 0xFE &&
    39	       packet->payload[1] == 0xED &&
    40	       packet->payload[2] == 0xFA &&
    41	       packet->payload[3] == 0xCE))
    42	    {
    43	      NDPI_LOG_INFO(ndpi_struct, "found Amazon Video on TCP\n");
    44	      ndpi_set_detected_protocol(ndpi_struct, flow, NDPI_PROTOCOL_AMAZON_VIDEO, NDPI_PROTOCOL_UNKNOWN);
    45	      return;
    46	    }
    47	  else if((packet->udp != NULL) &&
    48	           (packet->payload[0] == 0xDE &&
    49	            packet->payload[1] == 0xAD &&
    50	            packet->payload[2] == 0xBE &&
    51	            packet->payload[3] == 0xEF))
    52	    {
    53	      NDPI_LOG_INFO(ndpi_struct, "found Amazon Video on UDP\n");
    54	      ndpi_set_detected_protocol(ndpi_struct, flow, NDPI_PROTOCOL_AMAZON_VIDEO, NDPI_PROTOCOL_UNKNOWN);
    55	    } else {
    56	      NDPI_EXCLUDE_PROTO(ndpi_struct, flow);
    57	  }
    58	}
    59	
    60	void ndpi_search_amazon_video(struct ndpi_detection_module_struct *ndpi_struct, struct ndpi_flow_struct *flow)
    61	{
    62	  struct ndpi_packet_struct *packet = &flow->packet;
    63	
    64	  NDPI_LOG_DBG(ndpi_struct, "search amazon_video\n");
    65	
    66	  /* skip marked packets */
    67	  if(packet->detected_protocol_stack[0] != NDPI_PROTOCOL_AMAZON_VIDEO)
    68	    ndpi_check_amazon_video(ndpi_struct, flow);
    69	}
    70	
    71	
    72	void init_amazon_video_dissector(struct ndpi_detection_module_struct *ndpi_struct, u_int32_t *id, NDPI_PROTOCOL_BITMASK *detection_bitmask)
    73	{
    74	  ndpi_set_bitmask_protocol_detection("AMAZON_VIDEO", ndpi_struct, detection_bitmask, *id,
    75	                                      NDPI_PROTOCOL_AMAZON_VIDEO,
    76	                                      ndpi_search_amazon_video,
    77	                                      NDPI_SELECTION_BITMASK_PROTOCOL_TCP_OR_UDP_WITH_PAYLOAD,
    78	                                      SAVE_DETECTION_BITMASK_AS_UNKNOWN,
    79	                                      ADD_TO_DETECTION_BITMASK);
    80	  *id += 1;
    81	}
